scenario: Cannot calculate salary — Calculate button does nothing
expected: Result card appears with EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB and Net Pay values
notes: Most critical path. Must always work.

scenario: Page blank or not loading on open
expected: Full page loads within 3 seconds. Calculator visible.
notes: Check on Chrome, Safari, Firefox.

scenario: Cannot type in salary input field
input: Click on salary field and type RM3000
expected: Characters appear in field. Value accepted.
notes: Input field must be interactive.

scenario: Cannot download Salary Report — form does not open
expected: Modal form opens asking for email, user type, company, phone
notes: Critical lead capture feature.

scenario: Cannot download Salary Payslip — form does not open
expected: Modal form opens. download_via = 'Download Salary Payslip'
notes: Verify in Google Sheet after submit.

scenario: Google Sheets not recording submissions
input: Complete form and submit after clicking Download
expected: New row appears in Google Sheet with timestamp, email, userType, hiringStatus, companyName, userPhone, download_via
notes: Check sheet after every submission.

scenario: Privacy Policy page returns 404 in production
expected: Page loads at /privacy-policy with full content. No 404.
notes: Was a known issue — verify fix is live.

scenario: Empty salary field — calculator crashes
expected: No crash. Error logged. Result card does not show.
notes: Type 'errorlogs' to confirm error was captured.

scenario: Zero salary crashes or shows NaN
expected: All values = RM0.00. No NaN or crash.
notes: Divide-by-zero must be handled.

scenario: Negative salary produces wrong results
expected: Treated as 0 or rejected. No negative deductions.
notes: Must not produce negative EPF or net pay.

scenario: EPF rate incorrect — below RM5,000
expected: Employee EPF: RM330 (11%). Employer EPF: RM390 (13%).
notes: Verify both employee and employer rates.

scenario: EPF employer rate wrong above RM5,000
expected: Employee EPF: RM660 (11%). Employer EPF: RM720 (12%).
notes: Rate drops from 13% to 12% above RM5,000.

scenario: SOCSO not capping at RM5,000 ceiling
expected: SOCSO employee: RM69.05 (capped). No further increase.
notes: SOCSO is capped at RM5,000 wage ceiling.

scenario: EIS not capping at RM5,000 ceiling
expected: EIS employee: RM29.85 (capped). EIS employer: RM29.85 (capped).
notes: EIS ceiling is RM5,000 per month.

scenario: PCB not lower for married vs single employee
input: Gross: RM4,000, Married vs same salary Single
expected: Married PCB lower than Single. Net pay higher for married.
notes: Marital status must affect PCB calculation.

scenario: Bonus not included in EPF or PCB calculation
expected: EPF calculated on RM10,000. PCB annualised with bonus.
notes: Bonus must affect both EPF and PCB.

scenario: Page loads slower than 5 seconds
input: Open site on standard broadband connection
expected: Page interactive in under 3 seconds. Lighthouse score > 70.
notes: Use Google PageSpeed Insights to measure.

scenario: Wrong redirection after form submission
input: Submit download form with valid data
expected: PDF/email delivered or success message shown. No redirect to wrong page.
notes: Check UX flow after form submit.

scenario: Mobile layout broken — calculator not usable on phone
input: Open on iPhone / Android or resize to 375px
expected: All inputs, buttons and results visible. No overlapping or cut-off elements.
notes: Use Chrome DevTools device mode.

scenario: Non-citizen employee shows SOCSO or EIS
expected: SOCSO: RM0. EIS: RM0. EPF and PCB still apply.
notes: Non-citizens exempt from SOCSO and EIS.

scenario: Favicon not showing in browser tab
input: Open site in Chrome, Safari, Firefox
expected: Ricebowl logo appears in browser tab on all browsers.
notes: Minor visual issue. Does not affect function.

scenario: Text typo or wrong capitalization in UI
input: Read all visible text on page
expected: All text grammatically correct. No spelling errors.
notes: Review header, labels, tooltips and footer.

scenario: Spacing or alignment looks off on desktop
expected: All sections evenly spaced. No overlapping elements. Clean layout.
notes: Minor visual polish check.

scenario: Footer copyright year is outdated
expected: Copyright shows current year (2026).
notes: Update annually.

scenario: Colour inconsistency in buttons or badges
input: Check all buttons, badges and links
expected: All primary actions use consistent blue (#2563eb). No random colours.
notes: Visual consistency check.

scenario: Tooltip text missing or incorrect on deduction fields
input: Hover over EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB labels
expected: Tooltip appears explaining what each deduction is.
notes: Helpful for non-finance users.

scenario: Timestamp not recorded in Google Sheet
expected: Timestamp column in sheet shows correct date and time of submission.
notes: Auto-generated on form submit.

scenario: Error logger not capturing empty salary
input: Leave salary blank, click Calculate, type 'errorlogs' on page
expected: Popup shows log with type='input', message='Invalid salary input'.
notes: Verify error logging is active.

scenario: Error logs lost after page refresh
expected: Logs still visible after refresh. localStorage persists.
notes: Confirms localStorage is working.

scenario: Clear All Logs does not work
input: Open error log viewer, click Clear All Logs
expected: All logs removed. Viewer shows empty state message.
notes: Minor admin utility.
